questions.definition: A **slum** is an area of a city that is very poor and often has poor housing conditions.
options: a densely populated urban neighbourhood with inadequate infrastructure
a wealthy residential area with modern amenities
a rural village with fertile farmland
questions.answer: a densely populated urban neighbourhood with inadequate infrastructure

questions.definition: **To negotiate** means to discuss and agree on terms in a business or legal deal.
options: to walk away from a conversation abruptly
to arrange a meeting for the future
to discuss and reach an agreement
questions.answer: to discuss and reach an agreement

questions.definition: **To be on a high** means to feel very happy and excited.
options: to be in a state of deep sadness
to be extremely cheerful and energetic
questions.answer: to be extremely cheerful and energetic

questions.definition: **A trade union** is an organisation that represents workers and tries to improve their working conditions and wages.
options: a group of businesses in the same industry
a collective bargaining body for employees
questions.answer: a collective bargaining body for employees

questions.definition: **To be down** in a financial market means the prices of stocks and shares have fallen significantly.
options: to experience a sudden rise in stock prices
to see a steady increase in profits
to observe a sharp decline in market value
questions.answer: to observe a sharp decline in market value
